function mk takes nothing returns nothing
	local unit u=GetTriggerUnit()

		if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A07M')>=1)then
			call GroupRemoveUnit(er,u)
			set bo[GetUnitUserData((u))]=false
		elseif(GetUnitTypeId(u)=='h06B')then
			call ig(u)
		endif
		if(k!=null)then
			if(not IsUnitType(k,UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE))then
				set t=GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(k))
				set pi[t]=pi[t]+1
				set r=ea[GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(k))]
				set Pi[r]=Pi[r]+1
				call qd(2,r+1,I2S(Pi[r]))
				if(GetUnitTypeId(u)=='e00A')then
					call UnitDamageTarget(u,k,350.,true,false,ATTACK_TYPE_CHAOS,DAMAGE_TYPE_NORMAL,WEAPON_TYPE_WHOKNOWS)
				endif
				set t=GetUnitTypeId(k)
				if(t=='n00V' or t=='n01O' or t=='n02G')then
					call IssueImmediateOrderById(k,$D0084)
					call cB(k)
				elseif(t=='e00B')then
					call SetUnitLifePercentBJ(k,GetUnitLifePercent(k)+14.)
				elseif(t=='e00A')then
					call SetUnitLifePercentBJ(k,GetUnitLifePercent(k)+20.)
				elseif(t=='h01U' and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A08H')<=0 and(not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_MECHANICAL))and(not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_UNDEAD)))then
					call mG(k,u,'h01V')
					set u=null
				elseif(t=='h05H' and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A08H')<=0 and(not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_MECHANICAL))and(not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_UNDEAD)))then
					call mG(k,u,'h01U')
					set u=null
				elseif(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A07M')>=1)then
					call AB(u)
				endif
			endif
			if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A07G')<=0 and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A07H')<=0 and not IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_SUMMONED))then
				set t=ea[GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(u))]
				if(ji[t]>0 and GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0F5')>0)then
					set Bv=GetOwningPlayer(u)
					set bj_forLoopAIndexEnd=IMinBJ(20*eb(GetPlayerId(Bv)),400)
					call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(Nv,GetUnitX(u),GetUnitY(u),512.,rX)
				endif
				if(hi[t]>0)then
					call TriggerSleepAction(2.)
					if(u!=null and GetWidgetLife(u)<.405 and GetRandomInt(0,99)<IMinBJ(hi[t],40))then
						set k=CreateUnit(GetOwningPlayer(u),GetUnitTypeId(u),GetUnitX(u),GetUnitY(u),.0)
						call RemoveUnit(u)
						call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\Resurrect\\ResurrectCaster.mdl",k,"origin"))
						if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(k,'A07M')>=1)then
							call NB(k)
							call GroupAddUnit(er,k)
						endif
					endif
				endif
			endif
		endif
	elseif(IsUnitType(u,UNIT_TYPE_STRUCTURE))then
		call ZR(u)
		call eF(GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(u)),u)
		if(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0EL')>0)then
			call Eb(u)
		endif
		set t=GetUnitTypeId(u)
		if(t=='h05G')then
			call wf(u)
		elseif(t=='h059')then
			call Jf(u)
		elseif(t=='h063')then
			call Qb(u)
		elseif(t=='h008')then
			set t=GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(u))
			set yi[t]=yi[t]-1
		elseif(GetUnitAbilityLevel(u,'A0DS')>0)then
			call rb(u)
		elseif(t=='h061')then
			call Pb(u)
		endif
		call FlushChildHashtable(gr,GetHandleId(u))
		call GroupRemoveUnit(Oa,u)
		call GroupRemoveUnit(Da,u)
		set u=GetKillingUnit()
		if(u!=null and oX)then
			set t=ea[GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(u))]
			set Ki[t]=Ki[t]+1
			call qd(3,t+1,I2S(Ki[t]))
